BuildObjectRender(Object?)

Builds a property manipulation interface for the specified Godot object.

public static ISerializedPropertyManipulation? BuildObjectRender(Object? obj)

Parameters

obj Object

The Godot object to build the render for.

Returns

ISerializedPropertyManipulation

An ISerializedPropertyManipulation interface for the object, or null if unsupported.

Remarks

This method creates and caches property renderers for efficient property manipulation. Supported object types include Godot.Node and Godot.Resource.
